$comment-background: Hidden/minimized/inactive-tab blotters must never freeze (trading views). Measured evidence chain, all via CDP on the live platform: (1) Chromium freezes a hidden VIEW's WebContents regardless of process sharing — all blotter views stopped answering Runtime.evaluate while backgrounded, with clean shared affinities; (2) backgroundThrottling:false is INERT in OpenFin 43.142 at every level — manifest defaults did not reach views, platform-override stamping did not reach views, and runtime updateOptions({backgroundThrottling:false}) succeeds but getOptions still reports true; (3) freeze onset is minutes-fast. Therefore the runtime args below disable the background scheduler features process-wide (last working lever), AND every data window holds a Web Lock freeze-exemption (host-data acquireBackgroundFreezeExemption) as the scoped belt-and-braces. The defaultViewOptions/defaultWindowOptions backgroundThrottling:false entries are kept as statement-of-intent for a future runtime where the option works.
$comment-scrollbars: Native scrollbars use the platform default (Win11 Fluent: thin rounded thumb that expands on hover) — fully composited, and AG Grid gutters self-size via the grid's runtime scrollbarWidth probe either way. To switch to the classic always-thick square style instead, append FluentScrollbar,FluentOverlayScrollbar,OverlayScrollbar to the ONE comma-separated --disable-features flag (repeated flags don't merge). Arbitrary widths would require ::-webkit-scrollbar styling, which forces main-thread painted scrollbars — deliberately ruled out (see design-system styles/scrollbar.css AG exemption).
$comment-devtools: devtools_port + --remote-debugging-port together expose the OpenFin runtime to Chrome DevTools. Open chrome://inspect#devices in a separate Chrome window and click 'Configure...' → add 'localhost:9091', then SharedWorkers (data-services) appear under 'Other'.

platform.$comment-fdc3: OPTIONAL. The primary grid color-link transport is the OpenFin interop API (fin.me.interop) — present by default in every platform view/window, no manifest flag needed. fdc3InteropApi only injects window.fdc3, the FALLBACK transport used when interop is absent (e.g. views created outside the platform). If neither is available, StarGrid logs a loud console error at link init instead of silently dropping traffic. See docs/OPENFIN_GRID_LINKING.md.

customSettings.$comment-useRest: Master switch for REST mode. true + non-empty configServiceRestUrl → every ConfigManager in the platform writes to the REST server first, mirrors to Dexie, queues pendingSync on transient failures. false (or unset) → local Dexie only. Flip this single boolean to switch the whole platform between local and REST.
